\paragraph{Agent-interaction analysis.}
We reconstruct the structured observation, three domain proposals, E2E coordination input, deterministic verifier feedback, and final memory update for all 30 audited events. Each turn is linked to its saved OpenAI request/response identifiers and a SHA-256 digest of the reconstructed input. No coordinates or terminal identifiers are included.
